result.tx_hash_note: local correlation handle only (SHA3-256 of the canonical bytes); not a consensus transaction id — no block commits to it
result.confirmation: this transport does not confirm: watch for the transaction in a block via `getblockbyslot`. `finalized: true` on that block is the strongest signal this chain offers, but it is NOT a settlement guarantee — no slashing penalty backs it and it is not a latch; see `docs/integration/BLOCH-GENESIS4-EXCHANGE-INTEGRATION.md` §5
